items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009

ctx.x: I’m curious as to your relationship, the band in general, with the college. Was there a relationship? Did you have anything to do with the music department?

No not really. We were pretty much on our own. I will say that a lot of the faculty were sympathetic to our schedule if you will. I remember in a couple of instances having an assignment due on Monday and to go to the professor and say, you know, the band. And he’d say okay, turn it in Tuesday. And that was great, to get that kind of leniency. And Dean Tolles was very sympathetic, and some of the other professors thought well this is a good thing for the school, even though these kids are on the brink of ruin.…
And you were in a fraternity.
